Technology.materialsText: Moisture-resistant chipboard, veneer, and solid wood — every texture is chosen to stay flawless for years. 40+ finish options let you build a wardrobe that looks like it was designed specifically for your room.

Process.heading: How it works, step by step
Process.subtitle: From measuring the room to the finished wardrobe — three simple steps we go through together with you

steps.title: We measure the room
steps.text: Do it yourself with our guide, or have a specialist come measure the space precisely — accounting for every ledge, door, and vent, so the wardrobe fits like a glove, down to the millimeter.

steps.title: You build the configuration
steps.text: Series, number of sections, module layout, finishes and features — all tailored to your interior and budget.

steps.title: You get your finished wardrobe
steps.text: Turnkey manufacturing and installation — we deliver, assemble on site, and show you how to use every mechanism.

Production.detailAlt: A joiner working a wooden beam in the ARMADERO workshop
Production.heading: A workshop, not an assembly line
Production.text: ARMADERO is a team of joiners in Kyiv. Every wardrobe is built to order: a frame in moisture-resistant chipboard or solid oak, hardware from certified European suppliers, hand-assembled, joint to joint. Every mechanism is tested for 50,000 open cycles.
